- Ivo before Dev (9), after Hana (1), not 2 (Finn), 3 (Cara), 4 (Ben), 5 (Ann), 6 (Gus), 7 (Elif). Ivo = 8.
- Check Ann and Ivo ≥3 apart: |5 − 8| = 3 ✓.

- Check Ann and Finn ≥3 apart: |5 − 2| = 3 ✓.

All constraints satisfied!
